key_risks: Rapid de-escalation or resolution of Strait of Hormuz blockade reversing oil price gains
FOMC July 29 decision or Warsh testimony producing unexpected hawkish signals
Weaker-than-expected July CPI or retail sales data triggering broad equity rotation away from cyclicals

portfolio.rationale: Geopolitical blockade in Strait of Hormuz and rising Brent/WTI prices provide near-term catalyst for energy sector through August 14 close.
Record Q2 bank profits, strong markets revenue, and resilient consumer spending support outperformance over the one-month window.
Broad market exposure to capture any risk-on rotation while maintaining benchmark-relative performance.

portfolio_rationale: Concentrated tilt to energy and financials captures the dominant near-term catalysts of Middle East supply risk and bank earnings strength, with core S&P 500 allocation for liquidity and benchmark tracking.
rationale_summary: Energy benefits from unresolved Hormuz tensions and elevated oil prices; financials from above-expectation bank results; overall allocation balances catalyst exposure with broad equity participation over the July 14 to August 14 window.
